tasks.title: Build a Sentence
Yoga Class Schedule
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently joined a new yoga class at your local community center. The instructor, Mr. Davis, has been very welcoming and helpful. However, you find the class schedule inconvenient and would prefer if the classes were held at a different time that fits better with your daily routine.
bullets: Thank him for his support and guidance in the yoga class.
Explain why the current class schedule is inconvenient for you.
Suggest alternative times that would work better for you and possibly other participants.
tasks.subject: Yoga Class Schedule Change
tasks.sample:
Dear Mr. Davis,

Thank you for your support and guidance in the community-center yoga class. You have made the sessions welcoming, and I have already learned a great deal from your instruction.

The current class time is difficult for me to keep. I finish work at 5:30 p.m., and the evening session starts before I can reach the center, so I have already missed two meetings. I am worried that I will fall behind if the schedule stays the same.

Would it be possible to offer a later evening class, perhaps at 7:00 p.m., or a weekend morning option? I have spoken with two other participants who would also prefer one of those times. I would be grateful for your thoughts and happy to help collect other students' availability.

Thank you again for your teaching.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：感谢指导、说明现有时间不便、提出更合适的备选时间。称呼 Mr. Davis。

tasks.title: Fast Fashion
tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: Fast fashion refers to the rapid production of inexpensive clothing for mass-market sales. Fast fashion allows consumers to buy trendy items at low prices and provides job opportunities in manufacturing countries. But critics argue that fast fashion leads to vast amounts of pollution in the form of discarded clothing, which harms the environment, and that workers experience poor working conditions. In your view, what would be the most effective solution to the problems associated with fast fashion?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I believe that laws should be created to hold fashion brands accountable for the problems their products create. This responsibility could push them to innovate and create new, environmentally friendly production methods. These innovations might not only reduce environmental damage but also improve conditions for workers.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: Based on my experience, today's consumers demand products that are made in environmentally and socially responsible ways. As a result, market forces are effective at getting companies to adopt better practices voluntarily. Consumer demand can encourage positive change without the need for strict accountability being imposed on clothing makers.

tasks.sample: I agree with Andrew that stronger legal accountability is the most effective solution to the problems created by fast fashion. Consumer preferences can influence companies, but voluntary change is often uneven because firms still have an incentive to keep prices low. A government could require large clothing brands to disclose factory conditions, reduce hazardous waste, and finance collection programs for unwanted garments. For example, if every major retailer had to accept used clothing and report how much material was recycled, companies would have a reason to design products that last longer and are easier to reuse. Kelly is right that consumer demand matters, but customers cannot verify every supply chain on their own. Clear standards would give shoppers reliable information and ensure that responsible companies are not placed at a cost disadvantage.
tasks.analysis: 需表态并回应对方。较好答法：法律问责更有效，消费者压力有用但不足以核实供应链。
